<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.9" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#728887"/>
      <stop offset="0.42" stop-color="#263333"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="panel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#465454"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#111818"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="180%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="7" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".65"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="180%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".7"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <ellipse cx="302" cy="205" rx="155" ry="138" fill="#000000" opacity=".28"/>
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="617" rx="168" ry="190" fill="#000000" opacity=".32"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, sans-serif">
    <text x="22" y="28" font-size="14" font-weight="600">9:41</text>
    <text x="266" y="28" font-size="11">5G</text>
    <rect x="291" y="18" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="298" y="15" width="4" height="13" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="305" y="12" width="4" height="16" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="21" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="21" x2="336" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="348" y="14" width="21" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="350" y="16" width="15" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="370" y="18" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- header controls -->
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="25" y1="62" x2="52" y2="62"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="70" x2="52" y2="70"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="78" x2="52" y2="78"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="63" r="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="349" cy="78" rx="12" ry="7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- brand -->
  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="77" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="195,61 199,76 195,91 191,76" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="181" y1="84" x2="209" y2="68" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="181" y1="68" x2="209" y2="84" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="195" y="120" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width=".25">Mercedes-Benz</text>
  </g>

  <!-- vehicle visual panel -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="145" width="346" height="194" rx="23" fill="url(#panel)" opacity=".94"/>
    <polygon points="57,277 90,226 145,209 246,207 302,229 340,277" fill="#101717"/>
    <polygon points="101,224 143,211 238,211 276,230 119,230" fill="#728887" opacity=".62"/>
    <polygon points="141,214 180,214 180,229 122,229" fill="#050707"/>
    <polygon points="187,214 232,215 267,229 187,229" fill="#050707"/>
    <rect x="80" y="269" width="229" height="10" rx="5" fill="#465454"/>
    <circle cx="119" cy="281" r="24" fill="#080B0B" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="5"/>
    <circle cx="119" cy="281" r="9" fill="#465454"/>
    <circle cx="271" cy="281" r="24" fill="#080B0B" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="5"/>
    <circle cx="271" cy="281" r="9" fill="#465454"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="308" x2="336" y2="308" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1" opacity=".6"/>
    <text x="42" y="324" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".7">THE ART OF MOVEMENT</text>
    <text x="348" y="324" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#7EC0F6">01 / 03</text>
  </g>

  <!-- welcome heading -->
  <text x="28" y="382" font-family="Aubrey, sans-serif" font-size="30" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#soft)">Welcome</text>
  <text x="28" y="410" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".72">Your Mercedes-Benz experience starts here.</text>

  <!-- auth buttons -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="28" y="435" width="334" height="54" rx="13" fill="#728887"/>
    <text x="195" y="469" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Log in</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="501" width="334" height="54" rx="13" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".68" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="195" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- voice prompt card -->
  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <rect x="28" y="579" width="334" height="78" rx="23" fill="#465454" fill-opacity=".72"/>
    <circle cx="69" cy="618" r="24" fill="#728887"/>
    <circle cx="69" cy="612" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="64" y="617" width="10" height="14" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="60" y1="622" x2="60" y2="625" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="78" y1="622" x2="78" y2="625" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="69" y1="632" x2="69" y2="636" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="108" y="611" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".7">VOICE ASSISTANCE</text>
    <text x="108" y="635" font-family="Nobile, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#FFFFFF">Say “Hello Mercedes!”</text>
  </g>

  <!-- status / trust row -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="38" cy="690" r="4" fill="#7EC0F6"/>
    <text x="50" y="695" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Connected to your digital world</text>
    <line x1="28" y1="713" x2="362" y2="713" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".18"/>
    <text x="28" y="739" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".66">Manage your vehicle, journeys and profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".72"/>
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polygon points="41,789 52,780 63,789 63,802 42,802"/>
    <polyline points="37,789 52,776 67,789"/>
    <circle cx="130" cy="787" r="8"/>
    <line x1="136" y1="793" x2="143" y2="800"/>
    <rect x="204" y="779" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/>
    <circle cx="213" cy="787" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="299" cy="785" r="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="299" cy="800" rx="14" ry="7"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="52" y="821" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
    <text x="130" y="821" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Explore</text>
    <text x="213" y="821" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Vehicle</text>
    <text x="299" y="821" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Account</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="166" y1="840" x2="224" y2="840" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
